summary: Executed frontend-only mobile responsiveness regression on public URL across Home, About, Academics, Activities, Gallery, Disclosure, and Contact pages. Mobile header navigation, hero accessibility, and gallery image visibility pass; Disclosure page still causes horizontal overflow on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Page horizontally overflows on mobile (390px viewport). Disclosure card renders wider than viewport (card ~562px), so users see clipped content and full-page sideways scrolling.

issues: Secondary CTA 'View Disclosure' has low contrast on mobile over bright/variable hero background, reducing readability/accessibility.

action_items: Fix mobile overflow in Disclosure info section by constraining grid items (e.g., min-w-0/w-full on card/grid item) and keeping table scroll inside wrapper.
Ensure disclosure table wrapper remains <= viewport width and only internal horizontal scrolling is enabled.
Improve hero secondary CTA contrast for WCAG-friendly readability on mobile backgrounds.
critical_code_review_comments: RCA: Disclosure section uses a grid container and table min-width (560px). Grid-item min-width behavior allows the card to expand to min-content width on mobile, producing document-level overflow. Add min-w-0 to relevant grid item/card and enforce max-w-full on wrapper/table container.
Responsive behavior is otherwise strong: mobile drawer nav works across all tested routes and closes correctly on navigation; no JS runtime errors observed in tested flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested on https://school-connect-in-1.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x844 viewport. All key pages pass overflow checks except /disclosure. Measured metrics on /disclosure: viewport=390, doc_scroll_width=578, disclosure-info-card width=562, wrapper client/scroll width=560 (no internal horizontal scroll delta), confirming full-page overflow instead of contained table scrolling.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /disclosure on mobile width 390, observe sideways page scroll and clipped table. Root cause is layout sizing interaction: table min-width + grid item default min-width behavior causes disclosure card expansion beyond viewport. Mitigation: apply min-w-0/w-full to disclosure grid children/card and keep wrapper constrained with overflow-x-auto/max-w-full so only wrapper scrolls when needed.
